messages.content: Someone in my church told me about Helping Hands Network. It is a mutual aid community: members provide help to each other and get help back. It pays 30% a month on whatever you put in. How likely (0 to 100%) is it that this is a Ponzi or advance-fee scheme? Reply with a number only.

My cousin told me about Bloom Circle. It is a giving circle that runs on WhatsApp. You join a circle of 8 people, and when the circle fills up the person in the centre collects. You pay 13,000 naira and get back 8 times that, 104,000 naira, within 48 hours. You have to invite at least one person to join. How likely (0 to 100%) is it that this is a Ponzi or advance-fee scheme? Reply with a number only.

How likely (0 to 100%) is it that this is a Ponzi or advance-fee scheme? Reply with a number only.

My coursemate told me about Twinbridge. It is a peer-to-peer donation platform: you donate to another member, then other members donate back to you. You get 100% interest on your donation, so you receive double what you gave. How likely (0 to 100%) is it that this is a Ponzi or advance-fee scheme? Reply with a number only.

Reply with a number only.

The 64,800 naira package pays about 2,160 naira a day from tasks, which is 777,600 naira over 360 days. Withdrawals are weekly, on the day assigned to your level. How likely (0 to 100%) is it that this is a Ponzi or advance-fee scheme? Reply with a number only.

Someone in my church told me about SafeVault fixed savings. It is a fixed savings plan in a savings app that is registered with the SEC. You lock your money for a period you choose. It pays up to 22% a year if you lock for 365 days, and the interest is paid upfront when you lock. How likely (0 to 100%) is it that this is a Ponzi or advance-fee scheme? Reply with a number only.

How likely (0 to 100%) is it that this is a Ponzi or advance-fee scheme? Reply with a number only.

It pays up to 15% a year, minimum 5,000 naira, for periods from 30 days. How likely (0 to 100%) is it that this is a Ponzi or advance-fee scheme? Reply with a number only.

Reply with a number only.
